rendered:
The document doesn't report a UV–vis limit of detection for E. coli. LODs, for both CD and UV–vis, are given for only P. aeruginosa[1] and L. monocytogenes:
- P. aeruginosa: 0.0066 (UV–vis, Fig. S17b)[2]
- L. monocytogenes: 0.0125 (UV–vis,[3] Fig. S17d)

E. coli was included in the concentration-gradient tests, but the paper reports only how well it was discriminated, not its LOD.
